# Attach and explore

With the demo running, attach and read the symbols:

```text
[0x00000000]> fridaoj frida://attach/local//native_demo
{"ok":true,"result":{"action":"attach","pid":46117,"resumed":false,"state":"attached"}}

[0x00000000]> fridaSj native_demo
{"ok":true,"result":{"module":"native_demo","symbols":[
  {"name":"g_secret","address":"0x5c95c4681010","size":16},
  {"name":"g_attempts","address":"0x5c95c468103c","size":4},
  {"name":"check_key","address":"0x5c95c467e209","size":48},
  {"name":"bump_counter","address":"0x5c95c467e239","size":31},
  {"name":"main","address":"0x5c95c467e258","size":407},
  ...]}}
```

![Real symbols](img/native_journey/symbols.png)

Everything is named: `check_key` is a 48-byte function, `g_secret` is a
16-byte object in `.data`, `g_attempts` is 4 bytes in `.bss`.

> **Note:** addresses come from ASLR and change every launch. Read them from
> your own session.

On Android this chapter had to hook `RegisterNatives` to learn that
`SecretVault.nativeCheckSecret` lives at some address. Here the symbol table
gives us the addresses directly:

| Android | Native host |
|---|---|
| `fridaRNj` hook + spawn to capture | `fridaSj` symbol listing |
| static native methods, stripped library | actual `.symtab`, nothing hidden |
| addresses in the ART heap | addresses in the process memory map |

## Read the secret

```text
[0x00000000]> fridaxj 0x5c95c4681010 16
{"ok":true,"result":{"address":"0x5c95c4681010","size":16,"bytes":"4e34543156332d44334d302d4b335900"}}
```

`4e34543156332d44334d302d4b335900` decodes to `N4T1V3-D3M0-K3Y\0`: the key,
readable in memory. That is why patching it later will work.

## Read the counter

```text
[0x00000000]> fridaxj 0x5c95c468103c 4
{"ok":true,"result":{"address":"0x5c95c468103c","size":4,"bytes":"01000000"}}
```

The little-endian `01000000` is attempt number 1.

## Explore the ranges

```text
[0x00000000]> fridaRj
{"ok":true,"result":{"ranges":[{"base":"0x5c95c467e000","size":4096,"protection":"r-x","file":{...}},{"base":"0x5c95c4681000","size":4096,"protection":"rw-","file":{...}},...],"cached":false}}
```

The executable text page and the writable data page: the two regions
these chapters use.

::: {.callout-tip}
### Try

Attach, list symbols, read `g_secret`, read `g_attempts`, and feed a wrong
key to watch the counter tick.
:::
